newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens 300 MW generator in eastern Fujian.
newsitem.headline: China opens 300 MW generator in eastern Fujian.

text.p: A 300-megawatt expansion of a power plant in China's eastern Fujian province has begun operation, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.

The 300 megawatt generator, the second phase of the Huaxia Songyu power plant in a Taiwan-funded development zone in the booming port city of Xiamen, cost 3.0 billion yuan ($361 million) and went on line on Saturday, it said.
The first unit, put into operation last year, has produced 1.3 billion kilowatt hours, Xinhua said.

The plant is designed to have a total generating capacity of 1,200 megawatts and its first two generating units are expected to generate three billion kilowatt hours of electricity a year, alleviating power shortages in eastern Fujian, it said.
It is owned by the Xiamen Huaxia International Power Development Company, Xinhua said.
